description: This file defines a Spring REST controller class 'AnswerController' that manages CRUD operations related to 'Answer' entities associated with questions. It includes endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting answers linked to questions by their IDs.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling CRUD operations for Answer entities associated with questions.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all answers linked to a specific question.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer associated with a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer associated with a question.
